name: Week 13 Legs — Heal Week (Spotlight: Bulgarian Split Squat)
description: Heal week — hold all loads, cut volume. Squat holds at 75/side, run as a 3-set pyramid for cleaner depth. The Bulgarian split squat is the spotlight and the program's unilateral leg lift, introduced at light, form-only volume. Leg press holds 3 plates with the focus on full-ROM depth. The cool-down is hip/QL-biased.

dayOverview.theme: Heal week — hold loads, cut a set off each exercise. Squat holds 75/side as a 3-set pyramid. The Bulgarian split squat is the spotlight, introduced form-only at light volume. Leg press holds 3 plates with the focus on full-ROM depth. Cool-down biases toward hip and QL.

spotlights.why: The Bulgarian split squat is the program's unilateral leg lift. The rear foot stays fixed — no travel — which makes it more controlled, a better single-leg builder, and gentler on the QL. As a new movement the spotlight is the pattern: front-heel drive, vertical front shin, tall torso, at bodyweight or light DBs.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W11 leg press · W12 seated leg curl + calf raise · W13 Bulgarian split squat · W14 squat + incline RDL.
watchpoints: Heal week — hold loads, cut a set. Squat 3 sets, leg press 3, leg curl / incline RDL / calf raise 2 each. If a lift feels easy, that's the design — don't add reps or weight.
Squat holds at 75/side, run as a pyramid (8/6/8). The 6-rep middle set is the deepest, cleanest one — treat it as the quality set.
The Bulgarian split squat is new — introduce it, don't load it. Bodyweight or light DBs, 2 sets of 8-10 each leg, form-only. Smith machine if free; otherwise a bench and light DBs.
Leg press holds 3 plates — chase depth, not load. Full ROM is the work; the deep bottom position trains the core and QL.
QL/psoas watch. The cross-leg lateral lean is in the warmup for this. If anything in the QL talks during the warmup, modify the day — stop any lift that twinges.
Cool-down stays — 5-min block, hip/QL-biased on legs day.

sets.name: Warmup (incl. Cross-Leg Lateral Lean — QL/Psoas Release)

exercises.notes: Full depth, slow. Find where the hips are tight and breathe into it. Depth check before loading.

30s each side. Scissor one foot over the other, reach the same-side arm overhead, lean away from the back leg — the stretch runs down the side of the waist into the QL and lateral hip. Do this before loading the squat, especially if the QL feels tight.
Big slow circles. Wake up the hip stabilizers.
Spine mobility — slow, full ROM each direction.
Bodyweight. Use it as a QL check — if anything talks here, modify the day. Also previews the Bulgarian split squat pattern.

Standing, knees soft, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — the wrist dials a stretch up the back chain from forearm to lats to low back. A quick posterior-chain and low-back opener before loading the squat.
Set 1: 45/side x8. Set 2: 65/side x8. Same depth as the working sets.

**LOAD:** 75/side. Run as a pyramid — 8, then 6, then 8.

The 6-rep middle set is the quality set — make it the deepest and cleanest. Sets 1 and 3 at 8 bookend it.

**Cues:**
- Bar high on the upper traps (NOT the neck), upper-back shelf squeezed
- **Brace like prepping for a punch** — deep belly breath at the top, HOLD through the descent, exhale on the drive up
- **Hips back AND down**, not just down
- 'Spread the floor' — screw the feet into the ground
- Knees track over the toes
- Sit into the bottom
- Drive through the WHOLE foot

**Reflection:** does the 6-rep middle set feel like the cleanest, deepest one?

sets.name: Leg Press (3 Sets, 3 Plates, Full ROM)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 3 plates/side. 3 sets. Chase DEPTH, not load.

Full ROM at 3 plates is the work — the deep knee-to-chest position trains the core and QL at the bottom, not the leg muscles.

- **Foot position:** shoulder-width, mid-foot on the platform, slight toe-out — set before loading
- **Press through the WHOLE foot** — heels grounded
- **Full ROM** — knee toward the chest, actively pressing to keep the lower back from lifting off the pad
- Slow descent (3s), no bounce at the bottom
- Don't lock out hard at the top — leave a hair of bend
- If the hips lift off the pad at depth, that's too deep — back off
- **Breath:** in on the descent, out on the drive

sets.name: 🔆 Bulgarian Split Squat (Spotlight)

exercises.equipment: bench + light DBs — Smith machine if free (use smith-machine-bulgarian-split-squat)
exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** Bodyweight or light DBs (10-15lb at the sides max). 2 sets of 8-10 each leg. This is an introduction — the load is not the point.

The Bulgarian split squat is the program's unilateral leg lift. Rear foot fixed means no travel — more controlled, a better single-leg builder, gentler on the QL. Smith machine if it's free (`smith-machine-bulgarian-split-squat`); otherwise a flat bench for the rear foot and light DBs at the sides.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — drill the pattern every rep:**
- **Rear foot up on the bench** behind you, laces down or toes tucked
- **Step out far enough that the front shin stays roughly VERTICAL at the bottom** — too short a stance and the knee crashes past the toes
- **Front knee tracks over the front foot** — not caving in
- **Lower until the rear knee nearly touches the floor** — controlled, no dropping
- **Drive up through the FRONT HEEL** — the front leg does the work, the rear leg is a kickstand for balance
- **Torso stays TALL** — slight forward lean is fine, no folding over
- **2s descent**, own the bottom

**Reflection:** which is the limiter today — balance or strength? If it's balance, stay at bodyweight and groove the pattern. If the pattern is stable, light DBs are fine. Note any side-to-side asymmetry.

**QL watch:** still unilateral hip work — if anything in the QL/psoas talks, drop to bodyweight or cut to 1 set.

sets.notes: 2 sets, bodyweight or light DBs, form-only. The spotlight is the movement pattern.

sets.name: Calf Raise (2 Sets, Deep Heel-Drop + Slow Eccentric)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 3 plates/side, double-leg, on the incline leg press machine. 2 sets.

**Setup:**
- **Balls of both feet on the BOTTOM EDGE of the platform, heels hanging off the edge.** No plate under the foot — the platform edge gives the heel drop. This is a bottom-half-ROM movement.
- **Both feet on the platform** — double-leg

**Cues:**
- **Full stretch at the bottom** — let the heels drop as far below the edge as they'll go
- **Drive to FULL plantarflexion at the top**
- **3-4s eccentric** — the slow descent is the stimulus, not more weight
- **1s squeeze at the peak**, no bouncing
- **Breath:** continuous, don't hold

**LOAD:** 90. 2 sets.

**Cues:**
- **Ankles UNDER the pad** — the ankle bone is the contact point, NOT the mid-calf
- **Settings: 5/m/0/1** (verify before loading)
- **Lap pad locked DOWN firmly** — a loose pad lets the torso lift and turns it into lower-back work
- **Curl the heels toward the glutes** — full ROM, full squeeze
- **2s eccentric, 1s squeeze**
- Torso stays anchored to the seat, no lifting forward
- No bouncing out of the bottom

**LOAD:** 45lb plate. 2 sets. Dead slow with a 2s pause at the bottom.

**Cues:**
- Pad just below the hip crease (NOT the upper thigh, NOT the stomach)
- **Hip hinge** — a Romanian deadlift on the 45° bench, NOT a lumbar extension
- Lower back NEUTRAL throughout
- At the bottom, feel the stretch in the **hamstrings and glutes**, NOT the lower back
- Drive up by squeezing the glutes and hamstrings
- At the top, stop at neutral — past neutral loads the lumbar
- Tempo: 3s eccentric, 2s pause, 1s drive
- Take extra rest between sets if you need it

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Recovery Block (Hip/QL-Biased for Legs Day)

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Scissor the legs, reach overhead, lean away from the back leg — bookend the session with the same QL/psoas release as the warmup.
45s each side. Deep hip-flexor and glute release — the long hold is what lets the QL and psoas let go.
30s each side. Gentle twist for the QL — draw one knee across the body, opposite arm extended.
45s each side. Front leg + back leg at 90°. Sink the hips toward the floor — hip-rotator decompression.
60s slow breathing. Knees wide, arms extended forward. Parasympathetic shift before leaving the gym.

sets.notes: 5-min recovery block, hip/QL-biased on legs day — the chains that take the most load from squats, leg press, and the Bulgarian split squat. The cross-leg lateral lean opens it, child's pose closes it.

tips: Heal week — hold every load, cut a set off each exercise. Squat 3 sets, leg press 3, leg curl / incline RDL / calf raise 2 each. If a lift feels easy, that's the design.
Bulgarian split squat is the spotlight and a new lift — introduce it form-only: bodyweight or light DBs, 2 sets of 8-10 each leg. Smith machine if free, otherwise bench + light DBs.
Squat holds 75/side as a 3-set pyramid (8/6/8). Make the 6-rep middle set the deepest, cleanest one.
Leg press: hold 3 plates, chase depth. Full ROM is the work.
Cross-leg lateral lean is in the warmup and the cool-down — a QL/psoas release.
QL/psoas watch — use the warmup cross-leg lean, and stop any lift that twinges.
Cool-down stays — 5-min block, hip/QL-biased on legs day.
Rest 3 min squats, 2 min leg press, 90s Bulgarian and isolations.
formPhilosophy: Heal week — hold loads, cut sets. The squat pyramid and the leg-press depth focus are about quality at a held load. The Bulgarian split squat enters form first, load later — a heal week is a good week to learn a new movement with nothing heavy at stake. Building decades, not weeks.
